== Spelling: Gountis, not Gauntley ==
'''Build notes'''
* Both 2009 World Championship Day 2 sheets (2009 Worlds Day 2.pdf, pages 42–43) are handwritten "Matthew Gountis". They are filed alphabetically between Chris Gogolen (pages 40–41) and Joseph Graham (pages 44–45), which fits "Go-" and not "Ga-". His 2010 Day 2 list (2010 Worlds Day 2.pdf, page 42) is typed "Matthew Gountis". "Gauntley" was a misreading in the first transcription, so [[Matthew Gountis|Matthew Gauntley]] redirects here and the 2009 scan files were moved to the Gountis names.
